title: Recover U-VEND number-series checkbox route without repeating failed row click
purpose: Find a trustworthy Business Central UI route for U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos. after TARGET-036D2 proved that the visible row-scoped click did not persist.

sourceRefs.title: Microsoft Learn: Create number series
sourceRefs.claim: Default Nos. supports automatic numbering; Manual Nos. supports manual number entry.

targetRecord.optionalField: Manuelle Anz. / Manual Nos. only if explicitly selected later

entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2 result exists and is blocked.
D2 screenshot QA shows U-VEND row, Standardnr./Manuelle Anz. columns and non-persistent checkbox state.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND row is not uniquely visible.
Row focus cannot be verified before a checkbox action.
The UI focus moves to U-SO or another number series.
A route would change number-series lines, non-U-VEND setup, master data, documents, Preview Posting or Posting.
acceptanceCriteria: Either a new trustworthy U-VEND checkbox route is proven with before/after/reopen proof, or the blocker is narrowed to a specific UI limitation.
No Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
If Standardnr. is active after reopen, TARGET-036D3 first vendor retry may become ready-next; otherwise keep it blocked.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036D2 opened Number Series Page 456 in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE and proved U-VEND is visible with Standardnr. and Manuelle Anz. columns, but the visible row-scoped Standardnr. click route did not persist after reopen.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The vendor retry depends on U-VEND Standardnr. being active. Because the D2 click route did not persist and screenshot QA shows focus drift, a narrower route-recovery case is required first.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Directly recovers the blocked U-VEND checkbox route without repeating the failed row-scoped click.
Blocked until U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos. is proven active after reopen.
Item creation should wait until vendor numbering is closed and item numbering/base-unit route is checked.
Foundation blockers remain relevant before any document, Preview Posting or Posting flow.

queueChangesMade: Inserted TARGET-036D2B before TARGET-036D3 and TARGET-036E.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the exact screenshot-proven UI failure into a non-repeating recovery step and avoids creating vendors/items against a blocked number-series setup.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not change non-U-VEND number series.
Do not retry the same row-scoped coordinate click route.
requiredPreparation: Use screenshot QA to verify row focus before and after any action.
Probe alternative U-VEND-specific routes: editable checkbox focus, keyboard toggle, tooltip/page inspection/personalization, or a card/detail route if visible.
